question: On the EP (extreme-volume episodic pivot) cohort, do LOWER adr20 stocks give a better stop-R than HIGH adr20 stocks? Expect NEGATIVE top-minus-bottom (low vol wins), consistent with the low-volatility anomaly.
plain: Low-volatility anomaly (Pandey; MAS 2022): tests whether calmer stocks (lower adr20) produce better risk-adjusted stop-R on episodic-pivot gap events, which are typically the highest-volatility trigger.
